fields.why:
PlantSCADA trending for Pilgan has been extremely unstable for some time. Often it is unable to start up and trend files have to be cleared in order for the trend service to properly start up

Investigations indicate that one of the possible reasons is due to the way the trend files are configured. They are currently configured to one file per day, for 365 days, meaning we have over 11 million files that the file system is not capable of handling. Furthermore these all transition to a new file at the same time of 0:00 UTC putting additional strain on the drive storage

With the introduction of PI Historian, there shouldn’t be a requirement to keep 1 years worth of trends.
fields.design:
Change trend file size from 1 day to 1 week. Reduce trend file storage from 365 days to 13 week to get number of files to under 400k
Stagger trend file cutover time to reduce loading on drive storage
Review performance and adjust trend file size and/or storage if required to achieve stability
fields.impact: Built-in SCADA trends will hold 13 weeks of history; older data comes from PI Historian.
fields.scheduleNote: Implement on an ongoing basis through to December 2026.
